newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kwong Yik suspended pending de-listing.
newsitem.headline: Kwong Yik suspended pending de-listing.

text.p: Shares of Kwong Yik Bank Bhd were voluntarily suspended from trading on Wednesday, a Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange official said.
He did not give a reason for the suspension.
But the Rashid Hussain group of companies have said previously that the stock would be suspended to facilitate its merger with RHB Capital Bhd (formerly DCB Holdings Bhd).
Kwong Yik is tentatively scheduled to be de-listed from the exchange on August 11 after successful completion of the merger, Rashid Hussain said last week.
Under the new group structure, financial services firm Rashid Hussain Bhd now owns 58 percent equity in RHB Capital, which in turn controls 92 percent interest in Kwong Yik.
